+    def move_to_end(self, key, last=True):
+        """Move an existing member to the end, or to the beginning if last is false.
+
+        Raise KeyError if the member is not present.
+        """
+        node = self.map[key]
+        end = self.end
+        if node is (end[1] if last else end[2]):
+            return
+
+        prev, next = node[1], node[2]  # noqa: A001
+        prev[2] = next
+        next[1] = prev
+
+        if last:
+            prev, next = end[1], end
+        else:
+            prev, next = end, end[2]
+        node[1] = prev
+        node[2] = next
+        prev[2] = next[1] = node

+import pytest
+
+from marshmallow.orderedset import OrderedSet
+
+
+def test_move_to_each_endpoint_preserves_structure():
+    s = OrderedSet(["a", "b", "c"])
+    assert s.move_to_end("a") is None
+    assert list(s) == ["b", "c", "a"]
+    assert list(reversed(s)) == ["a", "c", "b"]
+    assert len(s) == 3
+    assert s == OrderedSet(["b", "c", "a"])
+    assert s.move_to_end("c", last=False) is None
+    assert list(s) == ["c", "b", "a"]
+    assert list(reversed(s)) == ["a", "b", "c"]
+    assert s.pop(last=False) == "c"
+    assert s.pop() == "a"
+    assert list(s) == ["b"]
+
+
+def test_repeated_moves_and_subsequent_mutations():
+    s = OrderedSet(["a", "b", "c"])
+    s.move_to_end("b")
+    s.move_to_end("b")
+    assert list(s) == ["a", "c", "b"]
+    s.move_to_end("c", last=False)
+    s.move_to_end("c", last=False)
+    assert list(s) == ["c", "a", "b"]
+    s.discard("a")
+    s.add("a")
+    assert list(s) == ["c", "b", "a"]
+
+
+def test_missing_empty_and_singleton_cases():
+    s = OrderedSet(["a", "b"])
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        s.move_to_end("missing")

+    assert list(reversed(s)) == ["b", "a"]
+    empty = OrderedSet()
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        empty.move_to_end("missing", last=False)
+    assert list(empty) == []
+    single = OrderedSet(["x"])
+    assert single.move_to_end("x") is None
+    assert single.move_to_end("x", last=False) is None
+    assert list(single) == ["x"]
+    assert single.pop() == "x"

With `last=True`, move the member to the end of iteration order; with `last=False`, move it to the beginning. Preserve every other member's relative order and leave membership and size unchanged. Return None. A missing key must raise KeyError without changing the set, and moving an endpoint or the sole member must be harmless. The operation should take constant time and preserve reverse iteration, discard, add, and endpoint-pop behavior.
